items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar

items.title: Obesity investing’s way forward, mapped
items.summary: Ben Zercher is senior analyst of biotech and pharma at PitchBook Obesity drugs offered the holy grail of drug development: a massive market, biology that works, and a proven blueprint paved by blockbuster GLP-1s. But the gold rush led by Big Pharma and investors has ended. The market is punishing developers whose drugs fail to stand out, and pipelines are being trimmed.
